# Game Idea: Pixel Runner

A simple endless side‑scroll runner built with HTML Canvas. The player controls a pixelated character that automatically runs to the right. Controls:
- **Space**: Jump over low obstacles.
- **Down Arrow**: Slide under high obstacles.

**Lose condition**: The game ends when the character collides with an obstacle or falls off the platform.

The game can be expanded with score tracking, increasing speed, and power‑ups.

<content>
1: // Simple endless runner targeting <canvas id="game">
2: // Player: 20x20 square, auto‑runs right, jumps with Space, slides with Down Arrow
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas not present
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
10:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400;
11: 
12:   // Game constants
13:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
14:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
15:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
16:   const GROUND_Y = HEIGHT - PLAYER_SIZE;
17:   const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
18: 
19:   let player = {
20:     x: 50,
21:     y: GROUND_Y,
22:     vy: 0,
23:     width: PLAYER_SIZE,
24:     height: PLAYER_SIZE,
25:     sliding: false,
26:   };
27: 
28:   const obstacles = [];
29:   let frames = 0;
30:   let gameOver = false;
31: 
32:   function spawnObstacle() {
33:     const height = Math.random() < 0.5 ? PLAYER_SIZE * 2 : PLAYER_SIZE;
34:     const width = PLAYER_SIZE * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : 2);
35:     const y = height > PLAYER_SIZE ? GROUND_Y - height : GROUND_Y - PLAYER_SIZE; // high vs low
36:     obstacles.push({ x: WIDTH, y, width, height });
37:   }
38: 
39:   function update() {
40:     if (gameOver) return;
41:     // player physics
42:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
43:     player.y += player.vy;
44:     if (player.y > GROUND_Y) {
45:       player.y = GROUND_Y;
46:       player.vy = 0;
47:     }
48:     // slide reduces height
49:     if (player.sliding) {
50:       player.height = PLAYER_SIZE / 2;
51:     } else {
52:       player.height = PLAYER_SIZE;
53:     }
54: 
55:     // move obstacles
56:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
57:       const o = obstacles[i];
58:       o.x -= SCROLL_SPEED;
59:       // remove off‑screen
60:       if (o.x + o.width < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
61:     }
62: 
63:     // spawn obstacles periodically
64:     if (frames % 120 === 0) spawnObstacle();
65: 
66:     // collision detection
67:     for (const o of obstacles) {
68:       const colliding =
69:         player.x < o.x + o.width &&
70:         player.x + player.width > o.x &&
71:         player.y < o.y + o.height &&
72:         player.y + player.height > o.y;
73:       if (colliding) {
74:         gameOver = true;
75:         break;
76:       }
77:     }
78: 
79:     frames++;
80:   }
81: 
82:   function draw() {
83:     // Background gradient sky
84:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, HEIGHT);
85:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // light blue
86:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#e0f7ff'); // pale cyan
87:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
88:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
89: 
90:     // Ground platform
91:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
92:     ctx.fillRect(0, GROUND_Y + PLAYER_SIZE, WIDTH, HEIGHT - (GROUND_Y + PLAYER_SIZE));
93: 
94:     // Player (rounded rectangle with a simple eye)
95:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
96:     ctx.beginPath();
97:     ctx.roundRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height, 4);
98:     ctx.fill();
99:     // eye
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
101:     ctx.beginPath();
102:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.width * 0.7, player.y + player.height * 0.3, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
103:     ctx.fill();
104: 
105:     // Obstacles (random pastel colors)
106:     for (const o of obstacles) {
107:       const hue = (o.x / WIDTH) * 360; // varying hue based on position
108:       ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(${hue}, 70%, 60%)`;
109:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height);
110:     }
111: 
112:     if (gameOver) {
113:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
114:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
115:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
116:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
117:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
118:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2);
119:       ctx.textAlign = 'start';
120:     }
121:   }
122: 
123:   function loop() {
124:     update();
125:     draw();
126:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
127:   }
128: 
129:   // Audio setup
130:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
131:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
132:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
133:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
134:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
135:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
136:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
137:     osc.start();
138:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
139:   }
140:   function playJump() { playTone(440, 0.1); }
141:   function playSlide() { playTone(200, 0.08); }
142:   function playGameOver() { playTone(100, 0.5); }
143: 
144:   // controls
145:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
146:     if (e.code === 'Space' && player.y === GROUND_Y) {
147:       player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
148:       playJump();
149:     }
150:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') {
151:       player.sliding = true;
152:       playSlide();
153:     }
154:   });
155:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
156:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') player.sliding = false;
157:   });
158: 
159:   // play game over sound in draw when needed
160:   const originalDraw = draw;
161:   function draw() {
162:     originalDraw();
163:     if (gameOver && !gameOverSoundPlayed) {
164:       playGameOver();
165:       gameOverSoundPlayed = true;
166:     }
167:   }
168:   let gameOverSoundPlayed = false;
169: 
170:   // start
171:   loop();
172: })();

(End of file - total 172 lines)
</content>
